With everything on the line, expect a tightly contested battle where every possession will matter.After rolling over Arizona in their Final Four game, Michigan is the early favorites to bring home the title. Yaxel Lendeborg will be limited after coming down with an injury in the game. The Huskies won't make it easy, and Dan Hurley will have his squad ready to win their third championship in four years.
